import csv, hashlib, io, json, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('products/sites/shopify-catalogue-example')
fixtures = root / 'fixtures'
baseline = fixtures / 'after-shopify.csv'
original = baseline.read_bytes()
command = [sys.executable, str(root/'verify_example.py'), str(fixtures/'before-variants.csv'), str(fixtures/'before-images.csv')]
def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def run(path):
    result = subprocess.run([*command, str(path)], capture_output=True, text=True)
    return {'exit': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr, 'sha256': digest(path.read_bytes())}
receipt = {'scope': 'Fictional worked example. Baseline and a two-cell barcode swap. No live import or customer delivery.', 'source_sha256': {str(Path(name).relative_to(root)): digest(Path(name).read_bytes()) for name in [*command[1:], str(root/'verify.py')]}, 'baseline': run(baseline)}
try:
    assert receipt['baseline']['exit'] == 0, 'Original fixture did not pass'
    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(original.decode('utf-8'), newline='')))
    header = rows[0]
    def column(suffix):
        matches = [i for i, name in enumerate(header) if name.strip().lower().split()[-1:] == [suffix]]
        assert len(matches) == 1, f'Expected one {suffix} column, found {matches}. Header: {header}'
        return matches[0]
    barcode, sku = column('barcode'), column('sku')
    candidates = [(i, row[barcode], row[sku]) for i, row in enumerate(rows[1:], 1) if row[sku] and row[barcode].isascii() and row[barcode].isdigit()]
    def encode(records):
        output = io.StringIO(newline='')
        csv.writer(output, lineterminator='\n').writerows(records)
        return output.getvalue().encode('utf-8')
    assert encode(rows) == original, 'CSV round trip changed fixture bytes before mutation'
    first, second = next((a,b) for a in candidates for b in candidates if a[0] < b[0] and a[1] != b[1] and a[2] != b[2])
    i, j = first[0], second[0]
    rows[i][barcode], rows[j][barcode] = rows[j][barcode], rows[i][barcode]
    mutated = encode(rows)
    before = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(original.decode('utf-8'), newline='')))
    changes = [{'record': r, 'column': header[c], 'sku': before[r][sku], 'before': old, 'after': new} for r, (left, right) in enumerate(zip(before, rows)) for c, (old, new) in enumerate(zip(left, right)) if old != new]
    assert [(change['record'], change['column']) for change in changes] == [(i,header[barcode]), (j,header[barcode])]
    receipt['manual_cell_comparison'] = changes
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
        path = Path(directory)/baseline.name
        path.write_bytes(mutated)
        receipt['swap'] = run(path)
    checks = json.loads(receipt['swap']['stdout'])
    receipt['isolated_grouped_failure'] = receipt['swap']['exit'] == 1 and checks['failed'] == ['identifiers_preserved_sku_barcode_color_size_price']
except (AssertionError, StopIteration, KeyError, ValueError) as error:
    receipt['diagnostic'] = str(error) or type(error).__name__
output = Path('products/services/stream-commerce-catalogue/director-isolated-barcode-control.json')
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))

description: The catalogue verifier passed the original fixture, but the prior reordered control also changed line endings and the latest attempt stopped before testing the barcode mutation. Run a byte-preserving control so the operator can see what the verifier detects and what still requires a separate SKU comparison. The Stream Commerce draft remains in its existing send-or-decline workflow. Commercial feedback is available with five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown.
